[P2] Require coverage for non-string operation names

Every added name-validation fixture supplies a string, so no assertion requires this rejection path. A regression allowing numeric names through could reach the core's overloaded `step()` implementation and create a failing operation instead of rejecting before any operation starts. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the validation/test design and require non-string names to produce `TypeError`, zero durable operations, and zero model calls.
